## Activity

During April 2022, North City Eye Clinic completed 436 retinal image captures. The activity was delivered through the scheduled clinic sessions, with session lists operating as planned apart from routine leave. Overall activity was recorded for the month and provides the basis for the image quality and grading results below.

## Image quality

Of the 436 captures, 10 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 2.3%. The result indicates that most images were suitable for assessment. The ungradable images should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, with any recurring issues considered as part of ongoing site operations.

## Grading

Grading identified 86 referable results from the images assessed. The median lag from image capture to completion of grading was 20 days. This measure should be reviewed alongside local workflow and session activity to support timely reporting. Continued monitoring of referral volumes, image quality and grading lag will help identify any changes in service performance at North City Eye Clinic.
